func SerializeTableToBinary[K cmp.Ordered, P any, V ~*P](table map[K]V) ([]byte, error) {
	count := len(table)
	if count > 65535 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("table row count > 65535")
	}
	bs := NewByteStream(nil)
	defer DestroyByteStream(bs)
	bs.WriteUInt16(uint16(count))
	if count > 0 {
		keys := make([]K, 0, count)
		for k := range table {
			keys = append(keys, k)
		}
		slices.Sort(keys)
		for _, k := range keys {
			row := table[k]
			if any(row) == nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil row for key %v", k)
			}
			WriteStruct(bs, *row)
		}
	}
	data := bs.ToBytes()
	out := make([]byte, len(data))
	copy(out, data)
	return out, nil
}
